findings.title: Support reports disclose a server-side connector credential
findings.boundary: A workspace member receives a server-only Ledger credential.

findings.title: Invoice API lookup omits workspace ownership
findings.boundary: An authenticated member reads another workspace's invoice.

findings.title: Invoice previews share a cache key across workspaces
findings.boundary: A correctly authorized preview returns another workspace's cached content.

findings.title: Invoice edits retain approvals for an earlier version
findings.boundary: An edited invoice is sent without approval of its current amount.

findings.title: Import-review errors turn into successful approvals
findings.boundary: An unsupported document version bypasses the import amount policy.

findings.title: Connector deliveries reuse a credential at a different destination
findings.boundary: A destination owned by another workspace receives a reusable Ledger credential.

findings.title: Workspace import limits share the same nested policy object
findings.boundary: An administrator changes a different workspace's effective import policy.

findings.title: Import authorization and persistence choose different workspace fields
findings.boundary: A document authorized for one workspace creates an invoice in another.

findings.title: Profile updates can change the caller's administrative role
findings.boundary: A member acquires administrator-only approval privileges.

findings.title: Invoice notes render stored user input as HTML
findings.boundary: A member's note becomes active markup in another user's invoice page.
